protocol.prompt_source: tests/skill-evals/cases.yaml; all twelve prompt strings were copied verbatim into runner tasks, and runners did not read the case file.
protocol.independence_scope: Control, treatment, and evaluator roles were separate Codex collaboration tasks; the original ten cases used batch tasks and the final two used isolated tasks.
audit_limitations: Runner identities and retrieval paths are self-reported from task context; they are not platform-signed execution logs.
The exact deployed model revision and sampling configuration were not exposed to the runners.
Stochastic outputs are not expected to reproduce byte-for-byte; hashes bind the exact recorded artifacts and working bundles actually assessed.
The original ten treatment cases used their historical committed bundle and one shared batch context; the final two used fresh isolated runners against the frozen working bundle recorded below.
All retrieval paths and runner bundle acknowledgements are self-reported rather than platform-signed.
CI validates artifact structure, hashes, paths, evidence excerpts, and arithmetic; it does not invoke a model or regenerate outputs.
protocol.post_run_annotation: Run IDs and manifest links were added above the raw case sections after collection; case response bodies were not rewritten.

skill_snapshot.note: The commit is the clean base revision; bundle_sha256 binds the exact uncommitted working-tree bundle acknowledged by both final isolated presentation/custom-emoji treatment runners.
